title: SimSandbox run file
description: One run of a model, kept beside it as <model>.<run>.run.json (ADR 0059): the events applied (schedule and recorded input, ADR 0058), the seed and settings used, and the model it was made with. Replaying it reproduces the run bit for bit.

model.description: The model file, relative to the run file.

model_hash.description: SHA-256 of the model as saved, with controls left out; a different hash means the model changed since the run was made.

seed.description: Used in place of the model's run.seed.

run.description: Run settings used in place of the model's.

inputs.description: The schedule in effect: values changed at set times, used in place of the model's run.inputs.

track.description: Recorded live input, [t, key, value] in the order it happened; each applies at the first step boundary at or after t.

set.description: A parameter key: block.param, or a declared parameter.
